author: Tina_D

title: Great food, great company & great guide
text: We had a great evening with Lorraine, who was very friendly and the perfect host for the evening. We had a small group of just 5 which was perfect for getting to know each other. We really enjoyed trying the various tapas and wines which were recommended by Lorraine. Will definitely try some of the venues again during our trip to Seville. We visited 4 different locations and ended our evening at a roof top bar overlooking the cathedral.
